NotamDTO.title: NotamDTO
NotamDTO.description:
Data Transfer Object (DTO) for a NOTAM (Notice to Air Missions).

Attributes:
    notam_number (str): The unique identifier for the NOTAM
    location (str): The facility designator/location identifier this NOTAM applies to
    starts_at (datetime): When this NOTAM becomes active
    ends_at (datetime): When this NOTAM expires
    message (str): The human-readable traditional format message
    icao_message (str): The ICAO format message
    interpretation (Optional[NotamInterpretationDTO]): Optional interpretation of the NOTAM content
